A blood-stained star is an ill omen, a fact not lost upon those against whom this weapon is brought to bear. Landing attacks slightly restores HP.

location.value: On a guarded Carriage being towed by two Trolls in Altus Plateau , travelling on the road southwest of the Road of Iniquity Side Path Site of Grace [ Map link ].; As of patch 1.06, this weapon is also dropped by Magnus the Beast Claw upon defeat [ Map Link ].; Video location
